question: In January 2022, which Indian tennis player announced his/her retirement after the 2022 tennis season?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sania Mirza.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Indian Star Tennis Player **Sania Mirza **Announce her** retirement in January 2022.**
 
• She has won** 6 grand slams** in his career.
 
• She is the **highest-ranked female tennis player from India** with a **rank of 27 in mid of 2007.**
 
• **Awards and recognition of Sania Mirza.**
 
 
• Arjuna Award- 2004
 
• WTA New commer of the year- 2005
 
• Padma Shri-2006
 
• Mejor Dyanchand Khel Ratna Award- 2015
 
• Padmabhusan-2016
